description_en: Queries the status information of private root CA instances or private subordinate CA instances purchased through the SSL Certificate Service console
description_zh: 查询您通过SSL证书服务控制台购买的私有根CA实例或私有子CA实例的状态信息
name: GetCAInstanceStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the private CA instance to query.

After you purchase a private CA instance in the Digital Certificate Management Service console (https://yundun.console.aliyun.com/?p=cas#/pca/rootlist), you can obtain the ID of the private CA instance by viewing the details of the private CA instance on the Private Certificates page.

Note: You must specify at least one of the InstanceId and Identifier parameters. If neither is specified, the API returns the 400 MissingParameter.instanceId/identifier error
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的私有CA实例的ID。

您在数字证书管理服务控制台 (https://yundun.console.aliyun.com/?p=cas#/pca/rootlist)购买私有CA实例后，可以在私有证书页面，通过查看私有CA实例的详情，获取私有CA实例的ID。

「注意：InstanceId 与 Identifier 至少须提供一个，未同时指定时 API 返回 400 MissingParameter.instanceId/identifier。」
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the client certificate or server certificate to query.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/330884.html operation to query the unique identifiers of all client certificates and server certificates.

Note: You must specify at least one of the InstanceId and Identifier parameters. If neither is specified, the API returns the 400 MissingParameter.instanceId/identifier error.

By specifying the Identifier parameter of a client certificate or server certificate, you can query the status information of the private CA instance that issued the certificate
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的客户端证书或服务端证书的唯一识别码。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/330884.html查询所有客户端证书和服务端证书的唯一识别码。

「注意：InstanceId 与 Identifier 至少须提供一个，未同时指定时 API 返回 400 MissingParameter.instanceId/identifier。」

「通过传入客户端证书或服务端证书的 Identifier，可查询签发该证书的私有 CA 实例的状态信息。」
parameters.name: identifier

InstanceStatusList.description_en: The status details of the private CA instances

AfterTime.description_en:
The expiration date of the private CA certificate. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

This parameter is returned only when Status is USED (the private CA instance is enabled) or REVOKE (the private CA instance is revoked)
AfterTime.description_zh:
私有CA证书的到期日期。使用时间戳格式表示，单位：毫秒。

只有当Status为USED（表示私有CA实例已启用）或REVOKE（表示私有CA实例已被吊销）时，才会返回该参数

BeforeTime.description_en:
The issuance date of the private CA certificate. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

This parameter is returned only when Status is USED (the private CA instance is enabled) or REVOKE (the private CA instance is revoked)
BeforeTime.description_zh:
私有CA证书的签发日期。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒。

只有当Status为USED（表示私有CA实例已启用）或REVOKE（表示私有CA实例已被吊销）时，才会返回该参数

CertIssuedCount.description_en: The number of certificates that have been issued by the private CA instance
CertIssuedCount.description_zh: 私有CA实例已经签发证书的数量

CertTotalCount.description_en:
The number of certificates that the private CA instance can issue.

For a private root CA instance whose Type is ROOT, this parameter indicates the number of subordinate CA certificates that can be issued.
For a private subordinate CA instance whose Type is SUB_ROOT, this parameter indicates the total number of client certificates and server certificates that can be issued
CertTotalCount.description_zh:
私有CA实例能够签发证书的数量。

对于私有根CA实例（Type为ROOT），该参数表示能够签发的子CA证书的数量。
对于私有子CA实例（Type为SUB_ROOT），该参数表示能够签发的客户端证书和服务端证书的总数量

Identifier.description_en:
The unique identifier of the private CA certificate.

This parameter is returned only when Status is USED (the private CA instance is enabled) or REVOKE (the private CA instance is revoked)
Identifier.description_zh:
私有CA证书的唯一标识码。

只有当Status为USED（表示私有CA实例已启用）或REVOKE（表示私有CA实例已被吊销）时，才会返回该参数

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the private CA instance

Status.description_en:
The status of the private CA instance. Valid values:

BUY: The instance is purchased but not enabled.
USED: The instance is enabled.
REFUND: The instance is refunded.
REVOKE: The instance is revoked
Status.description_zh:
私有CA实例的状态。取值：

BUY：表示已购买但是未启用。
USED：表示已启用。
REFUND：表示已退款。
REVOKE：表示已被吊销

Type.description_en:
The type of the private CA instance. Valid values:

ROOT: The instance is a root CA instance.
SUB_ROOT: The instance is a subordinate CA instance
Type.description_zh:
私有CA实例的类型。取值：

ROOT：表示根CA实例。
SUB_ROOT：表示子CA实例

UseExpireTime.description_en:
The expiration date of the private CA instance. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds.

This parameter corresponds to the subscription duration that you selected when you purchased the private CA instance, which is the duration of the Private Certificate Authority service
UseExpireTime.description_zh:
私有CA实例的到期日期。使用时间戳表示，单位：毫秒。

该参数对应您在购买私有CA实例时选择的购买时长，即PCA服务的时长
